assessment.requested_use: SSD recording plus computer USB shell through a normal USB hub
assessment.reason: SSD uses fp as USB host; the existing shell uses fp as a USB device. Both select the same controller's GCTL role field. A normal hub does not bridge two hosts.
assessment.hardware_max_slots_status: Not measured. HCSPARAMS1 at 0x21000004, bits 7:0. Do not confuse with CONFIG.MaxSlotsEn=1.
assessment.development_route: Keep fp in host mode; add multi-device host state, hub class management and downstream routing; connect a USB-device bridge to the PC and implement a host-side shell transport. The PC-facing bridge needs its own independent USB connection/controller.
driver_requirements: Own additional device/input contexts, control buffers and transfer rings; do not just relax Slot ID bounds.
Implement hub descriptors, port power/reset/status changes and child attach/detach.
Supply child speed, route string, root-port and applicable transaction-translator context.
Account for separate USB2 and SuperSpeed hub devices in a mixed-speed USB3 hub.
Serialize native shell execution and establish DMA ownership/completion; retain uncertain-command outcomes across reconnects.
Validate concurrent SSD recording, bridge traffic, unplug and power transitions before claiming support.
not_proven: fp silicon MaxSlots capacity or complete board USB topology
A second independent controller routed to the external USB-C connector
Concurrent host/device operation on fp's external connector
A working hub driver, bridge transport or deployable build
